description: G4 Sieverts-law steady-state oracle: surface concentrations fixed by c=K_S*sqrt(p), linear profile between.
provenance: Params are hand-picked (D=1e-9 m^2/s, L=1e-3 m, K_S=2.0 mol/m^3/Pa^1/2, p1=16.0 Pa, p2=1.0 Pa). Sieverts BCs give c0=K_S*sqrt(p1)=8.0 and cL=K_S*sqrt(p2)=2.0 mol/m^3; the trap-free steady profile is linear (G4) with J=D(c0-cL)/L=6.000000000000001e-06 mol/m^2/s (float64 rounding of 6e-6), inventory (c0+cL)L/2=5e-3 mol/m^2, permeability Phi=D*K_S=2e-9 mol/m/s/Pa^1/2. Algebraic gate tolerance 1e-12.
